mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and may reduce oral contraceptive efficacy through enterohepatic recirculation interference and CYP3A4 modulation, while estradiol can increase isotretinoin levels via protein binding displacement.
action: Isotretinoin is contraindicated in females of childbearing potential unless on two forms of contraception with reliable monitoring; estradiol-based contraceptives alone are insufficient and require additional barrier methods.
